description: On the desk in front, there’s a red cup and a blue cup near the right wall, with a red marker, a pencil, a yellow highlighter, and a blue paintbrush scattered between them. The left hand reaches forward and to the right toward the cups, pinches and lifts the blue paintbrush, then moves it over to the red cup and lowers it inside before releasing; the right hand stays near the blue cup, hovering without touching any object.
